title: The Painting Portal
description: A dimly lit ornate room with purple walls and a glass skylight contains a wooden desk with a lit green banker's lamp, scattered papers, a spray bottle, keys, and a yellow-gloved hand resting on the surface. A large painting on the right wall depicts a eerie green hallway with peeling paint, red exit sign, and a sign below reading 'STAFF ONLY DO NOT ENTER'.
prompt: An ornate purple-walled gallery room with a glass skylight at night, a wooden desk in the foreground with a glowing green banker's lamp, crumpled papers, spray bottle, keys and a yellow rubber-gloved hand. A large realistic painting hangs on the right wall showing a long decaying green hallway with peeling paint, flickering lights, red exit sign, and a small sign below the frame that reads 'STAFF ONLY DO NOT ENTER', surreal and unsettling atmosphere
